rows.en:
(Oh yeah, I lent Hoshimura my notebook.
I need to get it back.)

I lent you my notebook the other day, remember?
Could you give it back soon?

Oh yeah, I did borrow that, huh?
Hold yer horses a sec.
Whaaa~? I'm sure I put it in here...
Found it~!!

...Wait, huh? This is bread I bought a month ago.
Not this, um...
What?! Bread you bought a month ago?!
What are you so surprised about?

Well, of course I'm surprised!
Just how filthy is the inside of your desk?

It's not filthy~
I'm just a teeny bit bad at keeping things tidy,
that's all.
(I think it's way past a teeny bit...)

Besides, if a little thing like this surprises you,
you'll never be able to open my locker!

In there, whole new life forms could've
been born by now...
Go clean it out right now!

Whaaat~!
It's fine the way it is.
Probably... I'm sure......

(I'm way too scared to open it...
Hoshimura's locker, that is......)

(Oh yeah, I lent Yui my notebook.
I need to get it back.)
Hey, Yui.

I lent you my notebook the other day, remember?
Could I have it back soon?

Well, of course I'm surprised!
Just how filthy is the inside of your desk?
Go clean it out right now!

(I'm way too scared to open it...
Yui's locker, that is......)

(Looks like Hoshimura isn't here yet.
Is she taking the day off?)
All right, then. Let's begin class.
Juuust in tiiiiime!!

(Oh, Hoshimura.
So she just overslept and was running late.)
No... I'm afraid you're out, Hoshimura-kun.
Whaaat~! No way~

...Oh, but there's a perfectly good reason
I was late!
Oh? And what reason might that be?
Well, um, you see...

That's it!
The curse of the Kadun gave me sleep paralysis,
or something like that......!
rows.notes: Kadun: glossary (lore, Kadun of Battle; alone 'Kadun'). Yui is superstitious.

rows.en: Hoshimura-kun......... marked late.
rows.notes: Yamashiro writes it down ('chikoku to'), like c14157.

rows.en: Ahh... Have mercy, sir!
rows.notes: Go-mutai na (archaic 'how cruel/unreasonable'): 'Have mercy, sir!' keeps the old-fashioned flavour; 'sir' added for the teacher.

rows.en:
(I really don't think that excuse
was ever gonna fly, Hoshimura...)

(Looks like Yui isn't here yet.
Is she taking the day off?)

(Oh, Yui.
So she just overslept and was running late.)
Whaaat~ No way~

(I really don't think that excuse
was ever gonna fly, Yui...)

(Hm? A call from Hoshimura.
What could she want?)
Yoo-hoo~, you got a minute to talk?
Sure, I've got time.

Glad to hear it.
So, um... this is kinda hard to ask, but...
(It's rare for Hoshimura to hold back.)

Ask me anything.
I'll answer as best I can.

Much obliged! Then I'll just come out and ask.
Lemme see......

How can I get a dynamite body
like Nanase's?
I'm hanging up.
Wha?! Ah! Wait a sec......

(Calling me up over something like that...
What on earth is Hoshimura thinking?)

(Hm? A call from Yui.
What could she want?)
Sure, I've got time.
(It's rare for Yui to hold back.)

Ask me anything.
I'll answer as best I can.
I'm hanging up.

(Calling me up over something like that...
What on earth is Yui thinking?)
(Hm? What's that?)
rows.notes: Shared with scd_fes_805 (male); neutral, works there.

rows.en:
Yo-hooo! \p!
How ya doin'~!!
Ouuuch~~!!
Hahaha!!

Geez, what was that for, out of nowhere?!
Hoshimura!!

Sorry, sorry!
When I saw your back, \p,
I just had to smack it!
"Just had to," she says......
rows.notes: Shared by both genders; the player is talking about Yui, so 'she' is safe in both.

rows.en:
I said I'm sorry~
Well, I don't need anything in particular,
so see ya!
Huh? Ah, hey! Hoshimura!
(What was that all about, Hoshimura...?)
(Hm? What's that?)
Owww~~!!

Geez, what was that for, out of nowhere?!
Yui!!
Huh? Ah! Yui!
(What was that all about, Yui...?)

uncertain: c20308: go-mutai na (archaic 'how heartless') as 'Ahh... Have mercy, sir!'; 'sir' added since she pleads with Yamashiro-sensei.
